themes.title: OpenAI's last round: capital vs governance risk
themes.summary: OpenAI's capital structure firms up with a final $20B injection from Nvidia and SoftBank, while the same week brings researcher firings and a reported FTC look into safety practices at OpenAI and Anthropic. The tension: the sector's most valuable balance sheet is paired with rising governance scrutiny. Executives should track how board and regulatory risk is priced into AI supply-chain exposure.
themes.angle: Post-deal governance is now the swing factor in who can safely build on OpenAI.
